In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], a '''battle''' took place at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]. During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] push toward the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] sent Admiral [[Nammo]] and elements of the [[New Republic Third Fleet|New Republic Third Battle Group]] to seize [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. Nammo was defeated by Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]]. Bilbringi remained under Imperial control, but the New Republic nevertheless took Coruscant [[7 ABY/Legends|one year later]].
